caption: 25 ready-to-film Reel ideas land every week in the $1K Challenge, link in bio. These numbers come from Socialinsider's look at 6 million Reels posted by brands from January to June 2026. "Median" means the middle Reel in each length group, so one viral video can't skew the number. A good way to use this: pick the length that fits the job. Explaining a process or showing a before and after? Give it 45 to 60 seconds. Testing a new hook or format? A short Reel gets you an answer faster.
